[[Category:Title]] [[Category:Bourse]]
 The sinecure associated with this position was destroyed by the [[vyig]] in Spring 385YE.
==Overview==
Drusilla's Obelus was an [[Imperial title]] auctioned through the [[Bourse]]. Any Imperial citizen could hold the title. The position was a [[sinecure]], requiring minimal responsibility but offering a regular income of [[Bladeroot]]. It was destroyed by the [[vyig]] in [[Fade_out_again#We're_Victims_Of_The_Night_(Conjunction)|Spring 385YE]]. 

Following its destruction, evidence emerged that this Imperial sinecure had been shamelessly abused by the vyig. There was [[Anvil Court Report for Spring 385|ample evidence]] that Lukash Biessek von Temeschwar, who [[Construct Drusila's Obelus|commissioned the sinecure]] as [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]] intentionally meant for it to be used to smuggle the illegal substance ''bite'' into the Empire; they were ultimately executed for their long-standing role in the trade in Spring 385YE. The Obelus was ultimately burned to the ground by the vyig, in an apparent attempt to cover their trail.

==Responsibilities==
The Custodian had no particular responsibilities; they simply received a bounty of [[Bladeroot|bladeroot]] from Drusilla's Obelus and were responsible for protecting the Obelus from threats.

==Powers==
===Harvest of Bladeroot===
The Custodian received an income of 18 drams of bladeroot each season.

==Appointment==
Each custodian of Drusilla's Obelus was determined by auction through the [[Bourse]]. As an Imperial seat, any Imperial citizen could participate in the auction and hold the title. 

The custodian had [[tenure]], and served until they died or stepped down. As a title in the Bourse, they could not be [[revocation|revoked]] by the [[Synod]]
